title.narrative: Inspiring commitment to SDGs in the Caritas Latin America and the Caribbean community

description.narrative:
This project aims to ensure that Bishops’ Conferences in Latin America and the Caribbean have knowledge of and are committed to working towards the achievement of SDGs. Therefore, in 2018 Caritas Latin America & Caribbean (SELACC) will focus on inspiring and securing Church's commitment to this work, as part of the social dimension of evangelisation. In so doing, it will be crucial to take advantage of the 50th Anniversary of the General Conference of Latin American Bishops’ Conferences that took place in Medellín, Colombia.
SELACC hopes that the outcomes of this project will feed into drafting a final document that will illuminate, encourage, and, in 2019, will ensure that targeted actions aimed at contributing to the achievement of SDGs are being taken. This implies that the sub-regional meetings of Caritas organisations (Hondureñitos), in preparation for the XIX Latin American and the Caribbean Congress of Caritas, will need to adopt SDGs as a substantial piece of their work, particularly regarding the issues associated with the care for our Common Home.
It is expected that, as a result of this project, the Caritas Working Groups and at least 60% of national Caritas organisations will consider in their strategic plans the necessary strands of work to ensure collaboration with other actors towards the achievement of the SDGs. As a consequence, SELACC expects that their next Strategic Plan for 2019-2023, as well as the Operational Plans for 2019, will adopt these goals as one of their primary focuses.
